input.title: Cancel future Direct Debit collections
input.request: I want H&V to cancel my active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it cannot be used for future collections.

events.text: Direct Debit mandate: Northmere Fitness — Active.

summary: The customer asked Harrow & Vale to cancel their active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it can't be used for future collections. The desk classed it as a direct debit instruction and found no confirmation on record. It refused to submit the request, since the requester's verification was not established, and instead sent a query about the direct debit to the recurring payments system, which closed the case as asked. The mandate was not cancelled, and the record shows no reply from the recurring system and no next step.
